title: This Animal Survives 18 Minutes Without Oxygen Using a Plant Trick

scenes.text: This animal survives eighteen minutes with zero oxygen.
In a chamber with no oxygen at all, naked mole-rats passed out in thirty seconds, but their hearts kept beating.
Scientists found their trick: they switch fuel. Most mammals burn glucose, which needs oxygen.
Naked mole-rats burn fructose instead, a plant sugar. Until then, that trick had only been seen in plants.
They wake up fine, and researchers hope the same trick could one day protect hearts and brains during strokes.
